resolutions.rationale: Generalized the strict next-general-election endpoint in the core image and sense definition to an election-bounded particular Parliament and its lifespan, while retaining the fixed F-020 dissolution endpoint in the usage note.
Resolved together with the sense-structure finding by removing the absolute next-election persistence claim and leaving dissolution as the explicit formal endpoint.

Removed the potentially misleading whole-Parliament scope and specific-election attribution from the hung parliament usage line, retaining only the source-supported no-party-majority meaning and British-English qualification.
Deleted the unsupported restriction to political reporting; the usage note now stays within F-004's British-English and no-overall-majority support.
